command.name: security key-manager external show-status
command.description: This command displays connectivity information between ONTAP nodes and configured external key management servers.

parameter.name: node
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the connectivity information for only the given node.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the key management servers for only the given Vserver.

parameter.name: key-server
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the connectivity information for only the key management servers with the given primary key server host name or IP address listening on the given port.

parameter.name: key-server-status
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the connectivity information for only the key management servers with the given status.

parameter.name: status-details
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the connectivity information for only the key management servers with the given status details.

parameter.name: operational-status
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the connectivity information for only the key management servers with the given operational status.

parameter.name: secondary-key-servers
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the connectivity information of only the primary key management servers that have the given secondary key management servers.

parameter.name: kmip-version
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the connectivity information for only the key management servers with the given KMIP protocol version.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays the connectivity information for only the key management servers listening on the given port.

parameter.name: key-servers
parameter.description: Use this parameter to show the host name or IP address of the key management server(s).

parameter.name: roles
parameter.description: Use this parameter to show the role of the key management server(s).

parameter.name: key-server-status-list
parameter.description: Use this parameter to show the status of the key management server(s).

parameter.name: status-details-list
parameter.description: Use this parameter to show the status details of the key management server(s).

example.p: The following example lists all configured key management servers for all Vservers:
example.screen:
cluster-2::*> security key-manager external show-status
Node: sti219-vsim-sr044e Vserver: C1_sti219-vsim-sr044e_1711266079 Key Server Port: 12014 KMIP is operational: true
Key Server Role Server Status Reason ------------------- ------------ --------------- ------ 10.234.2.30 primary available - 10.237.80.83 secondary available - 10.237.80.223 secondary available -
Node: sti219-vsim-sr044f Vserver: C1_sti219-vsim-sr044e_1711266079 Key Server Port: 12014 KMIP is operational: true
Key Server Role Server Status Reason ------------------- ------------ --------------- ------ 10.234.2.30 primary available - 10.237.80.83 secondary available - 10.237.80.223 secondary available - 2 entries were displayed.
